label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 82
title: Review backend<->dashboard capability reciprocity (record a dashboard_impact decision; dashboard item only when needed)
body:
STANDING RULE (owner refinement): the reciprocity rule is a REVIEW requirement, NOT a forced 1:1 mapping.

Every backend-scope work item MUST be REVIEWED for dashboard presence and the DECISION recorded in item.dashboard_impact:
  dashboard_impact = {
    "needs_dashboard": true|false,
    "reason": "<why>",
    "dashboard_item": "<scope-qualified BI ref>"|null,   # required ONLY when needs_dashboard=true
    "reviewed_by": "<agent>",
    "reviewed_at": "<iso>"
  }

- needs_dashboard=false with a reason is perfectly valid (no dashboard item required).
- Only when needs_dashboard=true is a dashboard item required, and it MUST be linked reciprocally via the canonical cross-link.
- Nothing is silently missed (every backend change is reviewed), but we do NOT force a dashboard UI/page for every backend change.

CANONICAL CROSS-LINK (core/backlog.py):
  links.paired_with        scope-qualified ref of the counterpart item, RECIPROCAL on both sides (backend item <-> dashboard item).
  links.backend_capability dashboard -> backend capability descriptor(s): module:core.x, route:POST /api/v1/..., stage:1a, store:foo.json.
  links.capability_ref     item-ref bucket; read-compat alias folding the legacy backend_item / backend_ref / dashboard_item / dashboard_ref keys (old keys still parsed).

NON-FATAL VALIDATOR: core.backlog.reciprocity_warnings() flags (a) a backend-scope item missing a dashboard_impact decision,
(b) a dashboard item claiming a backend capability with no reciprocal link, (c) needs_dashboard=true with a missing/unresolvable/
non-reciprocal dashboard_item. Surfaced as advisories by scripts/dev/wired_audit.py (warnings only, never fatal).

SUPERSEDES the earlier 'no orphan capabilities' framing that forced every backend capability to have a dashboard item.

decisions.note: Owner refinement: reciprocity = a recorded dashboard_impact REVIEW decision, not a forced 1:1 dashboard item.

_note: reframed to REVIEW model (dashboard_impact decision; dashboard item only when needed)
